system.name: Employee onboarding readiness
system.intended_outcome: New hires can begin productive work on their first day with the required access and equipment.

diagnosis_rules.title: Readiness risk coincides with late manager inputs
diagnosis_rules.claim: In this sample, Day 1 readiness is below target while late manager inputs are above threshold. This is a lead for investigation, not proof that one caused the other.
diagnosis_rules.limitations: The sample is synthetic and aggregate. It cannot establish causality or identify affected employees.

response.action: Have People Ops review overdue onboarding cases and ask managers to confirm missing setup details; use the existing exception process for this cohort.
response.authority: People Ops lead approves any case routing; managers confirm their own submissions.
response.max_blast_radius: The affected onboarding cohort for the next start date
response.verification: Re-query the two signals and confirm Day 1 readiness returns to at least 95% after the missing details are resolved.
response.escalation: Escalate if source freshness fails, records conflict, or a proposed change would alter policy or decision rights.
